text: At its June 12, 2019 AGM, the Ralph Thornton Community Centre (RTCC) held elections to fill eight positions on its Board of Management. Eight individuals were nominated by the members to fill those vacancies. The following member retired from the Board upon the expiry of their two-year terms on June 12, 2019: Yang Han The following members retired from the Board during their two year appointment expiring in June 2020: Bernnitta Hawkins Daniella Moss The following members were nominated by the members at the June 12, 2019 Annual General Meeting to fill two-year terms effective June 2019: Ryan Acayan John Bradford Christine Chen Caleb Edwards Alan Lennon Julia Peters The above-noted terms will expire in 2021. The Toronto and East York Community Council appointed, at pleasure of Council, the following nominees to the Board of Management: 1. Two-year terms, effective June 2019: Ryan Acayan John Bradford Christine Chen Caleb Edwards Alan Lennon Julia Peters The above-noted terms will expire in 2021. 2. One-year term, effective June 2019: Sharon Ho Ed Nagy The above-noted term will expire in 2020.
